entities.summary: Salem Abdulrahman Mohamed Saleh is an Emirati chess grandmaster. He was awarded the title of Grandmaster by FIDE in 2009. Saleh competed in the FIDE World Cup in 2011, 2013, 2015, 2021 and 2023.
